findings.body:
Gain 4, Work 3, Harm 2
Raise: Not done. The page still renders cards from `_gather` while its totals come from `machine_board`. In the unchanged `_story` logic at `board.py:906–919`, an approved plan edited after its passing read still displays as approved or in progress, while `team.counts` and the JSON row classify it as planning. The separate `_part` logic at `board.py:942–969` also does not use shared-record readiness or the JSON time breakdown. Thus the page can disagree with `forge board --json` for named cases.
findings.title: Not done: HTML item states and times match board JSON

findings.body:
Gain 3, Work 2, Harm 2
Raise: Not done. The older merged-PR lookup runs only if an unfinished story has an older part. For a completed story whose part merged before the weekly search windows, `by_branch` lacks that part's PR body; lines 579–582 then assemble its runway from local logs alone. Teammates without those logs see different working, waiting and unknown time. The added older-part proof covers only an unfinished story.
findings.title: Not done: completed stories retain older parts in their runway

findings.body:
Gain 3, Work 1, Harm 1
Raise: Gate. The supplied proof list gives two bare `passed` lines under each claim, without a runnable test selector or check result that identifies the parametrized cases beginning here. Its counts, readiness, caching, approval and older-part claims therefore cannot be matched to named proof as required.
findings.title: Not done: proof list
